PAGE TITLE: FINANCIAL SECTION - FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, NOTES, AND REQUIRED SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION
01 NOTE 1 Reporting Entity and Summary of Significant Accounting Policies (CONTINUED)

KEY FACTS:
- For FERS employees hired January 1, 2013, and after, NASA contributes 18.4 percent of gross pay.
- CSRS employees: NASA makes contributions of 7.0 percent of gross pay.
- FERS employees hired before January 1, 2013: NASA makes contributions to the defined benefit plan of 16.0 percent of gross pay.
- The Agency also contributes 1.0 percent to a thrift savings plan (contribution plan) for each employee and matches employee contributions to this plan up to an additional 4.0 percent of gross pay.
- In FY 2024, NASA implemented SFFAS 54, Leases.
- SFFAS 49 requires agencies to assess and disclose P3s (between Federal and the private sector) involving risk-sharing or limited protections and unequitable long-term benefit/cost characteristics greater than five years.
